payload.title: Rust in the Compilation Explorer on riscv32im with a small no_std runtime
payload.description:
Feature: Rust explorer
  Scenario: A Rust while loop maps like C
    Given a Rust project with a while loop summing to n
    When it is explained at the unoptimized level
    Then user instructions link to source lines and library rows are collapsed
  Scenario: Safety checks can be shown
    When I turn on show safety checks
    Then the overflow check branch appears after the multiplication
